overview_description.description:
Dailymealz bringing together the best healthy food restaurants in Saudi Arabia and kuwait with skilled inventors to make a great everyday dining experience. Our engineers along with our professional drivers make eating a healthy food every day is simple.
The company was founded in 2017 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Meal Subscription Service
product.description: A subscription-based meal delivery service offering daily fresh meals from over 200 restaurants with options for weekly or monthly plans.

product.name: Corporate Meal Solutions (Dailymealz Business)
product.description: A corporate meal program offering customizable employee meal subscriptions, catering, and workplace food services with centralized billing and management.

product.name: Gift Card Subscription Service
product.description: A service enabling customers to purchase meal subscription gift cards for others, with options for work lunch or full-day meal plans.

product.name: Delivery Driver Application (Dailymealz Driver)
product.description: A mobile application for delivery drivers to manage and execute meal deliveries to customers efficiently.
